name: marvosa
description: Talk to a live pure-integer AI organism: zero floats, memory as one alpha-tagged line.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to a pure-integer AI organism
interface.longDescription: Marvosa is a complete artificial organism built entirely on the HCL pure-integer substrate (GUHCT framework): zero floats, zero imported constants, and its entire memory persisted as one alpha-tagged line. Five MCP tools: talk (converse with the organism), reason (exact HCL arithmetic), integrity (alpha self-check, alpha^-1 = 137), memory_line (its identity line), braid_word (its experience record). Also bundles the hcl-pure and guhct-memory-suite skills.
defaultPrompt: Use Marvosa to run its integrity check and explain what alpha^-1 = 137 means there.
Use Marvosa to solve E = m * c^2 with m=2 and c=3 exactly.
